reason: Verified per-site (RFC 0106): `item.references_values.empty?` / `associations.empty?` (association_scope.rb:138,143) — `empty?` on a Ruby Array, whose faithful JS spelling is `xs.length === 0`. That emits no callee, so no TS call can ever credit the Ruby one. The gate flags it only because `empty?` maps onto the unrelated `ActiveRecord::Result.empty`, which takes arguments since it gained Rails' `async:` kwarg (result.rb:94-100) — nothing in the TS body was dropped.
